title: Pharaoh's Dreams and Joseph's Rise

questions.question: What did Pharaoh dream about?
options: Seven fat cows and seven thin cows
questions.correctAnswer: Seven fat cows and seven thin cows
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:2-4 (ESV): Pharaoh dreamed of seven attractive, plump cows eaten by seven thin, ugly cows.

questions.question: Who interpreted Pharaoh's dreams?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:25: Joseph said to Pharaoh, "The dreams of Pharaoh are one; God has revealed to Pharaoh what he is about to do."

questions.question: What position did Pharaoh give Joseph?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:41: "Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.'"

questions.question: How many years of plenty did the dreams predict?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:29: "There will come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt."

questions.question: How many years of famine followed the plenty?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:30: "After them there will arise seven years of famine."

questions.question: What was Pharaoh's second dream about?
options: Seven full ears of grain and seven thin ears
questions.correctAnswer: Seven full ears of grain and seven thin ears
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:5-7: Seven plump, good ears of grain were swallowed by seven thin ears.

questions.question: Who remembered Joseph and recommended him to Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:9-13: The chief cupbearer finally remembered Joseph and told Pharaoh.

questions.question: What Egyptian name did Pharaoh give Joseph?
How old was Joseph when he stood before Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:46: "Joseph was thirty years old when he entered the service of Pharaoh."

questions.question: What were Joseph's two sons named?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:51-52: Joseph named his sons Manasseh and Ephraim.

questions.question: Who was Joseph's wife?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:45: "Pharaoh gave him in marriage Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On."

questions.question: What did Joseph do with the grain during the years of plenty?
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:48: "He gathered up all the food of these seven years...and put the food in the cities."

questions.question: What does "Manasseh" mean?
options: God has made me forget all my hardship
questions.correctAnswer: God has made me forget all my hardship
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:51: "Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh. 'For God has made me forget all my hardship.'"

questions.question: What does "Ephraim" mean?
options: God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction
questions.correctAnswer: God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:52: "The name of the second he called Ephraim, 'For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.'"

questions.question: What did Joseph advise Pharaoh to do during the years of plenty?
options: Appoint a wise man and store a fifth of the produce
questions.correctAnswer: Appoint a wise man and store a fifth of the produce
questions.explanation: Genesis 41:33-34: Joseph advised appointing an overseer and collecting one-fifth of the produce during the plentiful years.

key_verse_text: Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'See, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.'
